sentences.en: I became very nervous when I couldn't locate my passport.
sentences.zh: 我找不到护照时非常紧张。

sentences.en: The town is located in the extreme north of Japan.
sentences.zh: 这个城镇位于日本最北部。

sentences.en: The school is located at the foot of a hill.
sentences.zh: 这所学校坐落在一座小山脚下。

senses.zh: 找出, 指出(地点或位置) -
